user.title: TH5 Display
user.description: Pick the Inkbird TH5 running the th5_link ESPHome firmware, the weather entity for the forecast, and the place name shown on the panel.

data_description.device_id: An ESPHome device with th5_link. It must have connected to Home Assistant at least once.
data_description.weather_entity: Any weather entity with an hourly forecast, such as Met.no or Open-Meteo.

reconfigure.title: TH5 Display
reconfigure.description: Change the weather source or the place name. The new forecast is sent at the next sync.

data_description.weather_entity: Any weather entity with an hourly forecast, such as Met.no or Open-Meteo.

error.no_hourly_forecast: This weather entity has no hourly forecast.

options.cover: Cover (fill the picture area, crop the edges)

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Converts an image to the panel's four greys and switches the display to picture mode. It is sent at the device's next sync. The picture area is 416×240 px (26:15) full screen, or 416×181 px (≈ 2.30:1) under the top bar (switch Picture top bar); crop to that aspect ratio to fill it without borders or cropping.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The TH5. Optional when only one is set up.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The TH5 Display entry, instead of the device.

media.name: Image
media.description: A camera or image entity (one snapshot), a file in My media, or another image media source.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: How the image fills the picture area: 416×240 full screen, or 416×181 under the top bar.

refresh.name: Refresh forecast
refresh.description: Fetches the forecast and renders new frames now. They are sent at the device's next sync.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The TH5 Display entry, instead of the device.

install_firmware.name: Install firmware
install_firmware.description: Queues an MCU firmware package (.fwu) from the configuration directory, for test images. The device installs it at its next sync.
